invalidation_reasons: All four conditions were implemented sequentially inside one shared reasoning context.
Material cross-condition leakage prevents credible independent-condition comparison.

limitations: The run is invalidated and excluded from all benchmark conclusions regardless of the implementation checks that passed.

External Library of Congress destinations were counted but not followed during browser validation.
